description: Detection strategy descriptions for each LLM physics error class

E01_cg_coefficient_sign.method: Verify triangle inequality for angular momentum coupling. Check m₁+m₂=m₃ sum rule. Spot-check one CG coefficient against Varshalovich/Edmonds tables using scripts/spot_check.py.

E02_metric_signature_flip.method: Trace metric through every equation from Lagrangian to final result. Compute g_μν g^μν and verify equals spacetime dimension d. Check sign of kinetic terms in Lagrangian.

E03_ward_identity_violation.method: Replace polarization vector ε^μ with momentum k^μ in amplitude. Simplify q_μ·M^μ using sympy.simplify(). Verify cancellation to zero. Use scripts/ward_identity_check.py.

E04_wrong_eigenvalue_count.method: Count eigenvalues and verify total matches Hilbert space dimension. Check degeneracy structure against representation theory. Verify trace equals sum of eigenvalues.

E05_gauge_parameter_in_observable.method: Scan all final physical expressions for gauge parameter ξ. Verify ξ cancels completely. Check that S-matrix elements are gauge-independent. Compare cross sections at different ξ values.

E06_wrong_fourier_convention.method: Check 2π placement in all Fourier transforms. Verify transform-inverse pair normalizes correctly under stated convention. Compute one known transform pair numerically.

E07_missing_counterterm.method: List all divergent integrals in calculation. For each, verify corresponding counterterm exists and uses correct subtraction scheme. Check Z-factor consistency.

E08_unitarity_violation.method: Compute partial wave amplitudes a_J. Verify |a_J| ≤ 1 for all J. Check S†S = I relation. Verify optical theorem: σ_tot = Im(a₀)/(k²).

E09_causality_violation.method: Check propagator pole structure: poles must be on real axis or below (retarded). Verify no response before stimulus. Check analytic structure in complex frequency plane.

E10_negative_probability.method: Compute eigenvalues of density matrix. Verify all ≥ 0 and sum = 1. Check spectral function positivity. Verify probability distributions normalize to 1.

E11_wrong_limit_behavior.method: Compute actual limits using sympy.limit(). Compare computed limits against claimed behavior. Test multiple limit directions if applicable. Use scripts/limiting_case_check.py.

E12_dimension_mismatch.method: Track dimensions through all expressions using dimensional_check.py. Verify LHS and RHS dimensions match. Check dimensionless ratios. Use scripts/dimensional_check.py.

E13_order_of_magnitude_error.method: Spot-check numerical values against known physical scales. Verify unit conversions. Compare against literature values. Use scripts/spot_check.py.

E14_symmetry_breaking_error.method: Apply stated symmetry transformation to expression. Compute transformed expression and simplify. Verify invariance: simplify(expr_transformed - expr_original) = 0. Use scripts/symmetry_check.py.

E15_wrong_matsubara_convention.method: Check bosonic ω_n = 2nπ/β vs fermionic ω_n = (2n+1)π/β. Verify period β consistency. Check trace formulas use correct summation convention.

E16_wrong_spin_statistics.method: Verify commutation/anticommutation relations match spin (integer→commutation, half-integer→anticommutation). Check partition function uses correct sign. Verify distribution function type.

E17_wrong_coupling_sign.method: Trace coupling sign from Lagrangian through to physical result. Verify attractive/repulsive nature matches physical expectation. Check sign consistency in perturbation series.

E18_wrong_normalization.method: Compute normalization integrals numerically. Verify ∫|ψ|²dV = 1 for wavefunctions. Check propagator normalization. Verify partition function normalization. Use scripts/spot_check.py.

E19_wrong_propagator_structure.method: Check pole positions and residues. Verify numerator structure matches field type (scalar: 1, vector: -g_μν+..., spinor: (p_μγ^μ+m)). Compute propagator at known points.

E20_thermodynamic_limit_error.method: Verify correct limit order (N→∞ first, then other limits). Check extensive properties scale with N. Check intensive properties are N-independent. Verify entropy extensivity.

E21_wrong_renormalization_scheme.method: Verify renormalization scheme matches claim (on-shell, MS, MS-bar). Check subtraction point. Convert between schemes if needed using known relation. Compare against scheme-specific literature.

E22_wrong_canonical_quantization.method: Check commutation relations [x̂,p̂] = iℏ (or natural units). Verify operator ordering in products. Check i factors in commutators. Compare against standard textbook results.

E23_wrong_convergence_claim.method: Test numerical convergence at boundary values using scripts/convergence_check.py. Check analyticity domain. Verify series radius of convergence. Compute partial sums.

E24_wrong_boundary_condition.method: Verify boundary conditions match physical setup. Check Dirichlet/Neumann/periodic choice is appropriate. Verify boundary terms in integration by parts. Check compactification if applicable.

E25_missing_physical_effect.method: Enumerate all known physical effects in the regime from literature. Check each is included or explicitly excluded with justification. Compare against complete literature results for the regime.
